item.title: Refactor orders crate: order status string to OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
Operator request (authenticated, local chat): "The `orders` crate stores an order's status as a `String` and compares string literals all over the code. Refactor it to a proper type:

- Add `src/status.rs` with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }` deriving at least `Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash`.
- `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` returns the lowercase names ("pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled"); `Display` prints the same.
- `FromStr` for `OrderStatus` with `type Err = ParseStatusError`, a public error type that implements `std::error::Error` and whose message names the rejected input.
- `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool` encodes the lifecycle: pending -> paid, pending -> cancelled, paid -> shipped, paid -> cancelled; nothing else.
- `Order::status` becomes an `OrderStatus`; re-export `OrderStatus` and `ParseStatusError` from the crate root; use the enum everywhere, so the status string literals appear only in `src/status.rs`.

Observable behaviour (errors, report output and ordering, parsing) must stay exactly the same, and `cargo test` must pass. Commit your work."

Constraints: behaviour-preserving refactor; characterize existing behaviour (report output, ordering, parsing errors) before changing; keep functions under 60 lines; comments only where non-obvious; commit with the configured local git identity and no attribution beyond what the environment requires.

stages.summary:
Baseline and characterization for the orders crate OrderStatus refactor. No production code changed.

Structural goal (from brief): replace `Order::status: String` with an `OrderStatus` enum (Pending/Paid/Shipped/Cancelled), add `as_str`, `Display`, `FromStr` with `ParseStatusError`, `can_transition_to`, re-export from the crate root, and keep all observable behaviour identical.

Commits (branch archon/t9bt3tmk-refactor-orders-crate-order-status-strin):
- Original baseline: f49f5e1c5316b597b6adfdf3c4c38f6d15973700 (tree 6e35d20143ea2a04a1a2774dbb91a210c78ccdcf). This is attempt 1, so there was no prior work to reconcile.
- 59ac9a3 test: characterize status report ordering and CSV parsing
- 8caa647 test: characterize transition refusals and their messages
- f71ceaa test: characterize open, outstanding and shipping filters
- Final HEAD f71ceaa, tree 8e75e0d186ed6fd15d592706937935cea4e3ee2b. `git diff --stat f49f5e1..HEAD` shows only tests/characterization.rs (new, 233 lines). The worktree is clean. Nothing was pushed, and no servers or background processes were started.

Checks (cargo 1.98.1, CARGO_TARGET_DIR in the item cache):
- Before adding tests, at f49f5e1: `cargo test` exit 0, 3 integration tests pass (tests/orders.rs), 0 unit and 0 doc tests. `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` exit 0. `cargo fmt --check` exit 1: pre-existing diffs in src/billing.rs, src/order.rs, src/report.rs, src/shipping.rs and tests/orders.rs. I did not reformat them, since that is outside the brief.
- After adding tests, at HEAD: `cargo test` shows 14 characterization + 3 existing tests passing, with no FAILED lines. `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` exit 0. `rustfmt --check tests/characterization.rs` exit 0. `cargo fmt --check` still exit 1, for the same pre-existing files.
- The repo has no README, CI, Makefile or lint config, so these are the only discoverable checks.

Public-surface inventory (must stay unchanged unless noted):
- Order: pub fields id: u32, customer: String, total_cents: u64, status: String. Methods new(id, &str, u64) (initial status "pending"), is_open(), cancel() -> Result<(), String>.
- billing::pay(&mut Order) -> Result<(), String>; billing::outstanding_cents(&[Order]) -> u64.
- shipping::ship(&mut Order) -> Result<(), String>; shipping::ready_to_ship(&[Order]) -> Vec<u32>.
- report::status_counts(&[Order]) -> Vec<(String, usize)>, sorted by status name; report::to_line(&Order) -> String; report::from_line(&str) -> Result<Order, String>.
- Exact messages: "order {id} cannot be paid: it is {status}", "... cannot be shipped: ...", "... cannot be cancelled: ...", "expected 4 fields, got {n}", "bad id {:?}: {e}", "bad total {:?}: {e}", "unknown status {:?}".
- Allowed exception (brief): Order::status changes type to OrderStatus. Not explicitly allowed: changing the status_counts return type, and changing any error String.

Characterization coverage (all pass on the unchanged code):
- status_counts sorts alphabetically (cancelled, paid, pending, shipped), not in lifecycle order. This is the main trap: a derived Ord on the enum would silently reorder the report.
- status_counts of an empty slice is empty.
- to_line/from_line round-trip every status with exact text.
- from_line: wrong field counts (including empty line), exact bad-id/bad-total messages including u32 overflow, exact unknown-status message (case-sensitive, no inner trim, empty status), precedence id > total > status, whole-line trim only (customer fields are not trimmed; empty customer accepted).
- pay allowed only from pending, ship only from paid, cancel from pending/paid only. Refused calls return the exact message and leave the status unchanged. Successful calls set the expected status.
- is_open is true for pending/paid and false for shipped/cancelled. outstanding_cents counts only pending totals. ready_to_ship returns only paid ids, in input order.
- Existing lifecycle tests are unchanged.
- The tests are written through to_string()/Display and public functions, not by comparing order.status to a string. They should keep compiling if the field becomes an enum.

Known gaps and open decisions for the refactorer:
- Tests in tests/ still use status string literals. The brief says the literals should appear only in src/status.rs. The operator needs to decide whether that rule covers tests. I left them because the literals are the pinned contract.
- Changing the status_counts return type to OrderStatus is not explicitly allowed. If you do it, keep the alphabetical output order, for example by sorting on as_str().
- Mutation sanity was not run, so I have not proven these tests fail on a deliberately changed behaviour.
- Pre-existing fmt drift (see above) remains.

Feedback: none, first attempt.

stages.summary:
Refactored the orders crate so Order::status is an OrderStatus enum, in 3 commits on archon/t9bt3tmk-refactor-orders-crate-order-status-strin, on top of the existing characterization tests:
- 4725466 adds src/status.rs (OrderStatus with as_str, Display, FromStr with ParseStatusError, can_transition_to) and re-exports both from the crate root. Includes 2 small unit tests.
- afb1602 changes Order::status to OrderStatus and replaces the literal comparisons in order, billing, shipping and report. status_counts keeps its Vec<(String, usize)> return type and sorts by as_str(), so the alphabetical order is preserved. from_line keeps the exact 'unknown status {:?}' message.
- 19f7ecc routes pay, ship and cancel through can_transition_to. Allowed sets are unchanged.
No pre-existing test was modified.

Checks at HEAD 19f7ecc (tree d6d3b5947cc6a45261a972c868fa27649afc48c1): cargo test passes 2 unit + 14 characterization + 3 existing tests, with no FAILED lines. cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings exits 0. rustfmt --check passes on all touched src files. cargo fmt --check still reports one pre-existing diff in tests/orders.rs:40, which is outside the brief.

Public surface: Order::status type changed from String to OrderStatus, the brief's permitted exception. Everything else is unchanged, including error strings and status_counts' return type.

Limitations: status literals remain in tests/ (the pinned contract, left unchanged per the baseline's open decision). Mutation sanity was not run. Nothing is pushed and no background processes were started. The worktree is clean.

pr.body: Approach: src/status.rs adds OrderStatus (Pending/Paid/Shipped/Cancelled) with as_str, Display, FromStr (ParseStatusError), can_transition_to; re-exported from crate root. Order::status is OrderStatus. billing::pay, shipping::ship and Order::cancel check can_transition_to. report::status_counts keeps Vec<(String, usize)> and sorts by as_str() (BTreeMap on &'static str), so alphabetical order is preserved; the enum deliberately does not derive Ord. from_line maps ParseStatusError to the original 'unknown status {:?}' message. Checks: cargo test 2 unit + 14 characterization + 3 existing pass; clippy -D warnings clean. Tests unchanged. Left open: tests/ still use status literals (pinned contract); pre-existing fmt drift in tests/orders.rs; mutation sanity not run.
pr.summary: Order status is now a typed OrderStatus enum with parsing and lifecycle rules. Before: status was a String compared against literals in 4 modules. Now: literals live only in src/status.rs, transitions go through can_transition_to, report output and errors unchanged.
pr.title: refactor(orders): store order status as OrderStatus enum

risk.why: Changes the public type of pub field Order::status from String to OrderStatus, which breaks downstream callers that compare or assign strings. Cross-cutting across order, billing, shipping and report. Behaviour (errors, report output, ordering) is preserved and covered by 14 characterization tests.

Verified the OrderStatus refactor (HEAD 19f7ecc, tree d6d3b5947cc6a45261a972c868fa27649afc48c1) against baseline f49f5e1 and characterization f71ceaa. The worktree was clean before and after, and throwaway verification directories were removed. No servers or background processes were started.

Behaviour probe: a 60-line probe covering all transitions, status_counts, outstanding_cents, ready_to_ship, to_line, and 36 from_line edge inputs produces byte-identical output on the baseline and HEAD builds. Non-blocking notes: Order's Debug output now prints status: Pending instead of status: "pending". Status literals remain in tests/, which is the open decision the operator should confirm. Mutation sanity was not run.

Evidence is published as artifact verify-evidence (probe.rs, probe-base.out, probe-head.out, and the test, clippy, and fmt logs).
